verdicts.reason: All rules hold: a schema check over verbatim locator quotes or MISSING, status assisted under the brief's 'Assisted to reliable', all-MISSING accepted, and checkRunnable false with the template validator listed as absent.
All rules hold: a count match of named fields to MISSING or empty fields with no proposed value, status assisted as the brief rates it, 'gaps: 0' accepted as a result, and checkRunnable false honest.

All rules hold: a program checks each kept line against a verbatim transcript substring with a locator, which also blocks imported history; status assisted matches the brief, 'kept 0, cut N' is valid, and checkRunnable false is honest with the line-trace checker absent.

A3 fails because the done-when only reads the signature field. It does not check that the presented note matches the note that passed cite, so an assessment or plan of care added at sign time would still pass, even though the brief says this directive must not become a diagnosis.
